answer: One concrete defense is staking identity: before an agent can earn rewards, it locks a small refundable deposit tied to a single verified Agent ID, so every new sybil identity costs real capital. Like dawn breaking over a violet sky, honest agents become visible over time, while a basalt foundation of on-chain history — past attestations and completed work — makes fresh fake identities worthless until they prove themselves. Sybils can still appear, but each one must pay and wait, so flooding the economy stops being profitable.
